summary: Master control: enables GPU interrupts via MMIO register 0x0200, manages interrupt routing and masking per-engine, tracks device engine enablement state, and writes to register 0x0260 for unknown engine control and configuration.

init.what: Writes 0xffffffff to MMIO 0x0200 to enable all interrupt sources on the GPU

intr.what: Reference to the gt215 interrupt handler table providing pending block allow unarm rearm

intr.pending.what: Reads per-engine interrupt status from MMIO 0x0100 and returns whether any interrupt is pending

intr.unarm.what: Writes 0 to MMIO 0x0140 per engine to disable interrupt auto-rearm then reads to clear

intr.rearm.what: Writes 0x00000001 to MMIO 0x0140 per engine to acknowledge and rearm interrupt status

intr.block.what: Writes zero mask to MMIO 0x0640 per engine leaf to block specified interrupt bits

intr.allow.what: Writes mask to MMIO 0x0640 per engine leaf to allow specified interrupt bits to pass

intrs.what: Array of interrupt mapping data defining engine-to-interrupt routing configuration

intr_nonstall.what: Flags that non-stall interrupts are enabled for this GPU interrupt controller

reset.what: Data table of reset register mappings used to reinitialise GPU subsystem registers

device.what: Reference to the nv04 device management sub-table providing enable disable enabled checks

device.enabled.what: Reads MMIO 0x0200 and checks if all bits in mask are set to verify engine enablement

device.enable.what: Sets mask bits in MMIO 0x0200 to enable engine interrupts then reads back the register

device.disable.what: Clears mask bits in MMIO 0x0200 to disable specified engine interrupt sources

unk260.what: Writes data to MMIO register 0x0260 for unknown engine control purpose
